target_customer: Analog and mixed-signal chip design teams at semiconductor companies
problem: Analog circuit design is manual, slow and depends on scarce experts; engineers spend long cycles on topology choice, simulation and debugging.
business_model: Enterprise software for analog design teams (demo request, likely per seat or contract; pricing not public)
product_category: AI agents for analog circuit design (EDA)

founders.name: Sayan Mitra
founders.background_notes: From YC page. Some aggregators list Rithik Jain as CEO; YC page lists Mitra.

founders.name: Atman Kar
founders.background_notes: No education listed on YC page.

competitors.name: Astrus
competitors.what: Toronto startup automating analog IC layout with AI
competitors.funding_then: $8M led by Khosla Ventures (a separate report lists a seed of $11M CAD)

competitors.name: Celera
competitors.what: AI trainable models of circuit blocks to speed analog design

competitors.name: Simra
competitors.what: Agents for analog and mixed-signal circuit design

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must pick topologies, drive SPICE simulation and meet PDK specific constraints; analog design knowledge is tacit and hard to automate.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with customer PDKs and design documents could lock in teams, but several funded rivals and incumbents Cadence and Synopsys target the same workflow.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early; funded analog AI startups (Astrus, Celera) already ahead on capital.

market_need_then: Analog design remains a manual bottleneck in chip development and expert engineers are scarce; multiple startups raised money for it in 2025 and 2026.

identity.visual_style: Dark technical interface mockups with schematics and loop gain plots
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise, e.g. Spec in. Layout out.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Give your analog team superpowers

brand_strength.rationale: Clean and shorter than the former name, but no press about the brand and the meaning of the name is unknown.

outcome_analysis: Atrisa, formerly Refortifai, is a three person Spring 2026 company with engineers from KLA and Texas Instruments. No exit or failure exists. Its outcome will turn on whether agent output meets real analog specs and whether it can outpace better funded analog AI startups and the big EDA vendors.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, Caplight, FundedIQ) list a $500K pre-seed or accelerator round dated 2026-06 with Y Combinator; YesPress dates the YC investment 2026-03. Conflicting dates, no primary source, so not recorded as a round. The YC launch post was reported as posted 2026-06-02. Do not confuse with Astrus.
